If you're looking for the best KVM switch docking station in 2026, I'd focus on devices that combine USB-C/Thunderbolt docking, monitor switching, USB peripherals, and laptop charging in one unit.

My top picks depend on whether you're connecting two laptops, a laptop and desktop, or MacBooks.

Best KVM docking stations — top 5
Shop
Best overall for two laptops

AV Access iDock C20

$259.99

Dual 4K 60Hz monitors, two USB-C laptop connections, 60W charging per laptop, Ethernet and EDID emulation.

Best for two Windows laptops. Mac dual-monitor extension is limited.

Best Thunderbolt 4

Sabrent Thunderbolt 4 KVM Switch

$299.99

40Gbps Thunderbolt connectivity, support for dual 4K displays on compatible systems, and one-cable switching between two computers.

Best for Thunderbolt-equipped laptops and high-speed peripherals.

Best for Mac + Windows

StarTech 129N USB-C KVM Dock

$326.59

Dual 4K 60Hz DisplayPort outputs, DisplayLink support, five-port USB hub, Ethernet, and 90W/45W laptop charging.

Useful for Macs needing two extended monitors, but requires DisplayLink software.

Best value for laptop + desktop

AV Access KD-E10

$169.99

Dual 4K 60Hz monitors, USB-C laptop docking, desktop video connections, 100W charging and Ethernet.

Great value if one computer is a desktop PC.

Premium hybrid workstation

TESmart HDC202-X24

$699.00

Thunderbolt/USB-C laptop input, desktop connections, dual 4K 60Hz monitors, peripheral switching and EDID support.

Best for an elaborate laptop-plus-desktop setup.

These are current listed prices, not guaranteed checkout prices. Specifications and platform limitations are also discussed in recent KVM dock comparisons.
